hooks.command: p=$(printf '%s' "${TICKET_PREFIX:-isi}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); t=$(grep -oiE "${p}[-_]?[0-9]{3,5}" | head -1); [ -n "$t" ] && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"[Intake gate] Ticket %s detected. Run the intake skill before touching code."}}' "$t"; exit 0

p=$(printf '%s' "${TICKET_PREFIX:-isi}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); t=$(printf '%s' "$b" | grep -oiE "${p}[-_]?[0-9]{3,5}" | head -1); [ -n "$t" ] && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"[Intake gate] Branch %s references ticket %s. Run the intake skill before touching code."}}' "$b" "$t"; exit 0
